score.meaning: Strong implemented storyboard and staging, with purposeful order and useful restraint. The final invitation and mischievous payoff still rely on small facial/mitten distinctions; portrait composition trades immediate character presence for legibility. The number applies to inspected source and rendered sequence evidence only. Continuous editing rhythm remains not-yet-scored.

strengths: Investigate & share now has a concrete object of attention, an inspection with glasses, a consideration hold, and a return to the visitor. In motion.js:425–446 the antenna arrives at 150 ms, gaze at 330 ms, inspection at 790–1900 ms, return at 2350 ms, and presentation at 2720 ms. The authored and decoded sheets show the same order, with a quiet final hold through 4100 ms. This is a complete small sentence rather than an accumulation of gestures.

The warm selected lead ends its thought once. Keeping the wry afterthought available as a study preserves a legitimate alternative without making the default perform a second ending. The visible source difference is the extra 3050–4000 ms brow/eye beat in the wry variant; the simpler warm ending suits the owner's stated preference and this editorial brief.

One-peek is a meaningful, reversible economy experiment: the source removes the second close/reopen at 2190–2520 ms and holds the revelation after 1250 ms. The decoded paired sheet makes that difference inspectable. It does not enlarge the character, add a prop, or require sound to create a joke.

Surprise's earlier eye/O-mouth registration at 140 ms, then head recoil at 310 ms and wing answer at 650 ms, is visibly differentiated from the control by the 0.30-second decoded sample. Excited separates foot contact from head follow-through in source. Those are useful punctuation changes; neither observation proves their subjective sharpness at normal speed.

Portrait staging gives the unchanged small mitten and face enough display area to inspect. At 390 px both the question and moth fit within the shown stage, and the 320 px heading wraps without the former forced short line. Day and night evidence preserve the staged thought and four marked wings. No scenery, sound, or perpetual flutter is needed.

The signature remains a still until Play, with a settled pose and quiet controls afterwards. This leaves a usable reading pause and avoids repeated performance competing with the project question. Reduced motion maps to a purposeful still rather than a speeded-up version of the scene.

At the inspected display sizes the endpoint can be read as a friendly thinking pose without conveying a distinct invitation. This is my visual reading, not a claim that unfamiliar people failed to understand it.

Compare the transition and endpoint without the explanatory label; keep the current version unless the extra clarity survives at the intended size.

deductions.basis: mischievous-one-peek.png and decoded-day-2.png, especially 0.63/0.97 versus 1.30/1.63 seconds; motion.js:457–467
deductions.finding: Removing the second peek improves structural economy, but the payoff itself still occupies a narrow visual range between sleepy and knowing: one small half-eye carries most of the change. The antenna helps, yet the final soft smile and tucked hands remain close to a drowsy read. The alternative is ready to compare, not proven to be a stronger joke.
deductions.nextStep: Retain both candidates and compare silent normal-speed one-peek versus two-peek at the actual display size. Ask for the perceived intention before naming the emotion. Alter timing or gaze before enlarging anatomy or adding another action.

improvementCriteria: A label-free endpoint and the preceding return visibly distinguish invitation from consideration at intended desktop and phone sizes while retaining the tiny mitten and existing anatomy.
Normal-speed silent comparison establishes whether one held peek lands a clearer joke than two peeks; record owner preference separately from unfamiliar-observer interpretations.
Normal-speed observation of surprise, investigation and peek establishes distinct punctuation rather than assuming that source timings and sampled frames establish perceived rhythm.
For future website use, a fresh complete phone first viewport introduces the character and question with a deliberate reading order, then receives actual-device validation.
Keep the warm lead, single semantic ending, calm surrounding copy and stationary scene until evidence supports another action.

limits: I inspected decoded still sheets and film metadata; I did not watch continuous normal-speed motion and cannot award a perceived-rhythm or live-smoothness score.

The deterministic export establishes reproducible frames, not hardware scheduling. The focused desktop record includes approximately one-second gaps in both paused and playing observations; its cause is unestablished.
Portrait screenshots are browser evidence, not physical-phone behavior. No screen-reader speech or unprimed human response was observed.
Owner choice establishes personal fit for the warm lead, not stranger comprehension, attribution, attachment or recall.
Only the listed source portions and rendered evidence were inspected; this is not a comprehensive independent audit of all 24 live performances or all exports.
This is an AI specialist craft judgment. It cannot be presented as audience research or full-team consensus before pair discussion and the individual shared-scope vote.

fullInstructionsRead.name: review-animations
fullInstructionsRead.application: Separate purposeful content performance from frequent interface feedback; distinguish inspected behavior from subjective feel and state a scoped verdict.

fullInstructionsRead.name: animation-vocabulary
fullInstructionsRead.application: Use precise distinctions such as anticipation, follow-through, hold, interpolation and interruption rather than calling every motion a bounce or treating source duration as perceived duration. The glossary is terminology, not evidence of quality.

skillsReviewed.notClaimed: The other 14 full SKILL.md files were not read. Catalog inspection is recorded separately from full relevant intake. No skill was invoked to implement new features.

workflowChanges: Before future character or website motion, record each moving element's role, relationship and narrative reason. For this lead: antenna notices; gaze follows; glasses/head inspect; mitten presents; text, stage and surrounding chrome stay static.

Write a beat timeline before code, including a deliberate final hold and the action that ends the scene. Use separate budgets for quick controls and character content; one semantic ending is the default unless an afterthought adds meaning.
Review competing comic edits in a reversible comparison at matching scale and theme. Save the original, list the changed beats, and separate structural economy from perceived success.
Maintain two evidence columns in future reviews: what source/decoded samples establish, and what needs continuous playback, device testing or people. A cadence number never fills the second column.

Test replay, switching and interruption as editorial continuity as well as mechanics: inspect whether the incoming thought begins with the intended emotional state rather than an accidental smile reset.

For future website engineering handoff, provide the lead/support/static casting plus a first-viewport mobile composition. Ask engineers to preserve usable controls and reading order while measuring any expressive SVG workload before simplifying it.

rulesNotApplicableWithReason.rule: Product UI group budgets of roughly 300 ms and no keyboard-triggered motion
rulesNotApplicableWithReason.reason: The intentionally played 4.1-second character scene is the content. Apply short timing and immediate keyboard feedback to the controls; a keyboard activation of Play must still be able to play the requested scene.
Expressive SVG antenna/path articulation is part of the selected tiny character. Do not erase it for a generic compositor rule; investigate a measured relevant workload and retain geometry parity.

rulesNotApplicableWithReason.reason: These are useful future website interface checks, but antenna → gaze → inspection is character cause and effect, not staggered menu items. Its sequence is justified by intention.
